'''Jarn Harvus''' was an individual who explored the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Nim Drovis]] sometime before the [[Cold War (Galactic Republic–Sith Empire)|Cold War]] between the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic]] and the [[Sith Empire (Post–Great Hyperspace War)|reconstituted Sith Empire]]. While on Nim Drovis, Harvus discovered two new [[Species/Legends|species]] of fauna: a flying carrion-eater<ref name="Harvap">{{TORcite|type=codex|Harvap}}</ref> and an entirely unrelated but physically similar species.<ref name="Harvorisk">{{TORcite|type=codex|Harvorisk}}</ref> Harvus named the new creatures the [[harvap]]<ref name="Harvap" /> and the [[harvorisk]],<ref name="Harvorisk" /> and both species soon spread throughout [[Hutt Space/Legends|Hutt Space]].<ref name="Harvap" />

==Behind the scenes==
Jarn Harvus was mentioned in ''[[Star Wars: The Old Republic]]'', a [[Star Wars video games|video game]] released by [[BioWare]] in [[2011]], within the in-game Codex entries for the Harvap and the Harvorisk species.<ref name="Harvap" /><ref name="Harvorisk" />
